subject: Pilot renewal request — combined credit top-up + discount package
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@fjordlane.com>; procurement@fjordlane.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot renewal request — combined credit top-up + discount package

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo last week. The usage trend look promising and your engineers confirmed the integration path. To keep momentum and hit the internal go-live target you mentioned (mid-July), you asked for two things on the call: 1) an extra 250k tokens of free credits to cover peak testing, and 2) a short-term price concession on the first three months of committed usage.

Summary ask: 3-month trial extension (to 2026-08-15), 250k free token credit top-up, and a 10% discount on the first quarterly invoice after conversion.

I've attached your usage export for May and a draft quote (proposed_quote_fjordlane_v2.pdf). Can I get exec clearance for this combined concession? If approved I will send a revised SOW + DocuSign link to procurement.

Proposed commercial rationale (short): bridging period reduces churn risk, helps them complete end-to-end validation, and increases likelihood of a committed annual contract. Economics: concession reduces starter ARR by ~6k but increases probability of conversion from POC -> paid, estimated payback within first two quarters.

Thanks — M

--
Markus Klein
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@fjordlane.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot renewal request — combined credit top-up + discount package

Markus — appreciate the quick follow. The usage CSV matches what we saw internally. A few clarifications before procurement will sign:

- Can the credit be applied only to test/dev traffic (non-prod) and expire if we don't convert?
- Can the discount be structured as a one-time credit on the first invoice rather than a recurring rate change?
- We need a simple one-page MOU to attach to the internal approval case.

If you can confirm those points and send the MOU/quote we can route to procurement today.

Regards,
Alex
CTO, FjordLane Analytics
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot renewal request — combined credit top-up + discount package

Marissa/Naomi — forwarding Alex's clarifying questions. Quick exec ask below.

Ask for exec signoff: grant up to 250k token credit restricted to non-production namespaces, expire 90 days after issuance unless converted. Offer discount as a one-time invoice credit equal to 10% of the first invoice after conversion (cap $7,500). Extend pilot end-date to 2026-08-15.

Why approve: this is our standard bridge approach for accounts that are stalled on E2E validation. Expected uplift: higher chance of conversion and earlier committed spend. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/784/DL-2026-0784.

If you prefer different caps (credit amount or dollar cap on discount) say so. Legal will need to confirm wording for the MOU (I can draft). I can also include an explicit conversion clause that cancels credits if no commercial contract is signed by 2026-09-15.

Thanks,
M

Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot renewal request — combined credit top-up + discount package

Markus — reviewed. Conditional executive approval granted with the following constraints:

1) Credit: up to 225,000 tokens (reduce from 250k) scoped to non-production namespaces and issued as a redeemable credit code. Expires 90 days after issuance.
2) Discount: one-time invoice credit equal to 10% of the first post-conversion invoice, capped at $6,000.
3) Extension: pilot extended to 2026-08-15.
4) Conversion trigger: if a signed contract is not executed by 2026-09-15, any unused credits are forfeited and no further concessions apply.

Legal and Finance to confirm exact MOU language and the invoicing mechanism — CC'ing Finance Ops to start the billing carveout and Marissa to have Legal prepare a 1-page MOU. Once Legal produces the MOU, Markus can send to procurement with the DocuSign link.

Naomi
